notes: Collected = save XPInfo mastery UNION data/owned.json inventory; each row keeps owned/mastered flags and counts as collected on either.
Obtainable = WFCD masterable rows + Amp parts (WFCD never flags them masterable) + anything the save proves mastery-tracked; empty categories are dropped.

Category mapping: Warframes(+MechSuits->other) / Primary / Secondary / Melee / Sentinels / SentinelWeapons / Pets(companions) / Archwing / Arch-Gun / Arch-Melee, Misc: Amp->amps, K-Drive Component->kdrives, Kitgun Component->secondary.
Floor price = data/prices.json wts; candidates slug, slug_set, slug_blueprint (floor_kind says which one matched).
Icons: WFCD imageName -> cdn.warframestat.us/img (verified 200 + PNG bytes), else the warframe.market CDN path from data/wfm_items_v2.json, else null.
